description: This file defines an abstract base class 'JournaledGrain' for log-consistent grains using event sourcing within the Orleans framework. It provides core methods and properties for event raising, state management, and log view synchronization, serving as a foundation for specific grain implementations that utilize event sourcing for state persistence and consistency.

classes.name: JournaledGrain`1
classes.description: Abstract base class for event-sourcing grains, parameterized by grain state type.

classes.name: JournaledGrain`2
classes.description: Extends 'JournaledGrain' with support for event types, integrating log consistency and view adaptation functionalities.

methods.name: RaiseEvent
methods.description: Raises an event of type TEvent and submits it via the log view adaptor.

methods.name: RaiseConditionalEvent
methods.description: Attempts to raise an event conditionally; succeeds only if there are no conflicts.

methods.name: RaiseConditionalEvents
methods.description: Attempts to raise multiple events atomically, conditionally.

methods.name: OnTentativeStateChanged
methods.description: Virtual method invoked when tentative state may have changed.

methods.name: OnStateChanged
methods.description: Virtual method invoked when confirmed state may have changed.

methods.name: ConfirmEvents
methods.description: Waits until all previously raised events are confirmed.

methods.name: RefreshNow
methods.description: Synchronizes state and confirms all events to ensure strong consistency.

methods.name: RetrieveConfirmedEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a segment of confirmed events within a version range.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssue
methods.description: Handles connection issues in the log protocol.

methods.name: TransitionState
methods.description: Applies an event to the state; override to customize state transition.

methods.name: InstallAdaptor
methods.description: Initializes log view adaptor with provided factory and initial state.

methods.name: DefaultAdaptorFactory
methods.description: Provides default adaptor factory if none specified.

interfaces.name: ILogViewAdaptorHost`2
interfaces.description: Interface for log view adaptor host for state updates.

interfaces.name: ILogConsistencyProtocolParticipant
interfaces.description: Interface for log consistency protocol participant lifecycle.

interfaces.name: IConnectionIssueListener
interfaces.description: Interface to listen for connection issues.
